# Development installers

Latest: **Wallaby Agent V2 Development Build 9**, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS amd64. Install with a package manager to resolve dependencies. See the main README and VALIDATION.md before using wallet functions. The future Dashboard Wallet Builder needs DASHBOARD_BUILD9_UPDATE.md.

Historical development DEBs remain here unchanged. SHA256SUMS.txt includes the current and historical installers. Stable is unchanged.
